description: This file contains functions and classes for handling encrypted file storage, upload/download, decryption, and error handling within the Notesnook project. It manages file encryption, decryption, chunked uploads, and interactions with various storage backends, as well as error parsing and reporting.

classes.name: WrappedError
classes.description: Custom error class that wraps an underlying error with a message for better error handling and reporting.

methods.name: writeEncryptedFile
methods.description: Encrypts a file with a given key and stores it in the storage backend, reporting progress and handling errors.

methods.name: writeEncryptedBase64
methods.description: Converts base64 data to Uint8Array, hashes, encrypts, and stores it, returning metadata.

methods.name: hashBuffer
methods.description: Computes a hash of the provided data buffer using xxhash64.

methods.name: hashStream
methods.description: Hashes data from a readable stream using xxhash64.

methods.name: readEncrypted
methods.description: Reads and decrypts an encrypted file, returning the decrypted data.

methods.name: decryptFile
methods.description: Decrypts a file and saves it locally with the original filename.

methods.name: streamingDecryptFile
methods.description: Streams and decrypts a file based on its metadata.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Decrypts a file and triggers a save dialog for the user.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a file from storage or via API, with error handling.

methods.name: getUploadedFileSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of an uploaded file from the server.

methods.name: bulkExists
methods.description: Checks existence of multiple files in storage.

methods.name: FileStorage
methods.description: Object exposing file storage operations such as encrypting, decrypting, uploading, downloading, and deleting files.
